summary.zh: 危險訊號 3 檔都是跌破 200 日線，偏多訊號 9 檔以超賣反彈為主
summary.en: All 3 warning signals are breaks below the 200-day MA; 9 bullish signals are mostly oversold rebounds

text.zh: COST 下跌 0.45%，RSI 70.2 進入超買區，MACD 偏空、均線仍多頭排列
text.en: COST fell 0.45%; RSI 70.2 is in overbought territory, MACD bearish, MAs still in bullish alignment

text.zh: AMZN 下跌 3.12%、TSLA 下跌 1.18%，兩檔都跌破 200 日線，MACD 偏空、均線盤整
text.en: AMZN fell 3.12% and TSLA 1.18%; both broke below the 200-day MA, with bearish MACD and range-bound MAs

text.zh: LLY 下跌 1.09%，RSI 56.3、MACD 偏空，均線由多頭排列轉為盤整
text.en: LLY fell 1.09%; RSI 56.3, MACD bearish, MAs now range-bound

text.zh: XLE 上漲 0.74%，RSI 38.6、MACD 偏空、均線盤整

text.en: AMZN, TSLA and 2330.TW broke below the 200-day MA; 2330.TW also shows an oversold-rebound signal

text.zh: 過去 5 年跌破 200 日線後 20 天平均 1.43%、上漲機率 56.74%，和平常差不多
text.en: Over 5 years, 20 days after a 200-day MA break averaged 1.43% with a 56.74% up rate, similar to normal

text.zh: 超賣反彈出現在 006208.TW、2330.TW、CAT、GOOGL、INTC、PLTR、TSM、VT

text.zh: 超賣反彈過去 5 年後 20 天平均 3.16%，高於平常的 1.73%，有參考價值
text.en: Over 5 years, oversold rebounds averaged 3.16% over the next 20 days vs 1.73% normally, a useful signal

text.zh: BND 上漲 0.34% 並突破 200 日線；此規則過去表現和平常差不多
text.en: BND rose 0.34% and broke above the 200-day MA; historically this rule performed similar to normal

summary.zh: 財經新聞聚焦 SpaceX 衛星與股價波動、輝達執行長的消息，以及假期零售
summary.en: News focused on SpaceX satellites and share swings, Nvidia CEO headlines and holiday retail

text.zh: 美國副總統 Vance 表示獲告知黃仁勳並未遭司法部調查
text.en: Vance said he was assured Jensen Huang was not under DOJ investigation

text.zh: SpaceX 獲 FCC 核准部署 100 萬顆軌道資料中心衛星；另有報導其股價因算力需求疑慮重挫
text.en: SpaceX won FCC approval for 1 million orbital data-center satellites; another report said its shares crashed on compute-demand concerns

text.zh: 選擇權交易員押注 VIX 不會再升高；梅西百貨感恩節遊行因惡劣天氣延期
text.en: Options traders bet against a higher VIX; Macy's postponed its Thanksgiving Day Parade due to severe weather

text.zh: 路透：Boehly 簽署美方支持的換股協議，收購 Lukoil 海外資產
text.en: Reuters: Boehly signed a US-backed share swap deal to acquire Lukoil's global assets

text.zh: COST：報導指震盪市況下資金轉向穩定的零售股 Costco，但仍有考驗待觀察
text.en: COST: reports say Wall Street gravitates to reliable retailer Costco in a rocky market, though a test looms

text.zh: AMZN：聯邦法院在電商產品安全案中判 CPSC 勝訴；另有文章列它為避開 AI 回檔的科技股

text.zh: TSLA：報導 Altimeter 新建立約 6.8 億美元的 Tesla 部位
text.en: TSLA: reports say Altimeter opened a roughly $680 million Tesla stake

text.zh: LLY：醫療保健類股午後走弱；XLE：能源類股 11/24 午後走高
